theory: Crocodile is Luffy's mother
reason: Fan theory based on Ivankov's secret about Crocodile. No evidence supports this. Oda confirmed Luffy's mother is alive and has been drawn (background character).

theory: Zoro will die at the end of One Piece
reason: Based on Thriller Bark sacrifice scene. Oda stated he wants a happy ending. Zoro taking Luffy's pain showed loyalty, not death foreshadowing.

theory: Sanji is secretly a D. carrier
reason: Sanji is confirmed as Vinsmoke Sanji. His lineage is fully revealed - modified human with no D. connection.
lesson: Wanting characters to be more special than they are

theory: Buggy will become Pirate King
reason: Comedic theory. While Buggy keeps failing upward, the story clearly builds Luffy as the one to find One Piece. Buggy's luck is for comedy.

theory: Shanks is evil/a villain
reason: While Shanks meeting with Gorosei is suspicious, his actions consistently support Luffy. He stopped Marineford war to save lives. Likely has complex motivations, not evil.

theory: One Piece is the destruction of the Red Line
reason: Partially true but incomplete. One Piece is confirmed to be a physical treasure. Destroying Red Line may be a RESULT of finding it, not the treasure itself.

theory: Luffy will have Gear 6
reason: Gear 5 is Luffy's awakening and peak form. Oda stated Gear 5 = Nika form is his final power-up. No Gear 6 needed.

theory: Sabo killed Cobra
reason: Chapter 1085 revealed Im/Gorosei killed Cobra. Sabo was framed. He witnessed the murder and Im's existence.
lesson: Assuming the obvious suspect is guilty

theory: Kaido is a fish who ate Human-Human fruit
reason: While his fruit IS Fish-Fish Fruit Model Dragon, Kaido was born an Oni, not a fish. The fruit name references the legend of carp becoming dragon.

theory: Green Bull will join Straw Hats
reason: Ryokugyu shown as antagonist in Wano. He's a Marine Admiral loyal to Celestial Dragons. No redemption arc indicated.
lesson: Wanting every cool character to join crew

theory: Brook ate a Mythical Zoan
reason: Brook's Yomi Yomi no Mi is confirmed Paramecia. His soul powers are the fruit's awakening, not Zoan transformation.

theory: Kuina is alive as Tashigi
reason: Kuina died in chapter 5. Tashigi just looks similar - Oda uses similar character designs. No evidence they're the same person.

theory: Yamato will be 11th Straw Hat
reason: Yamato chose to stay in Wano to protect it, following Oden's path of guarding Wano first. May join later but not as permanent member yet.
lesson: Assuming all allies become crew members

theory: One Piece will end in 5 years (said in 2019)
reason: Oda consistently underestimates timeline. Said 5 years in 2019, we're in 2025 and still ongoing. Story takes as long as needed.

theory: All Straw Hats will get Conqueror's Haki
reason: Conqueror's Haki is 1 in a million. Only Luffy and Zoro confirmed in crew. Others have strong wills but not this rare ability.

theory: Blackbeard has three souls/personalities
reason: While his body is 'abnormal' allowing two fruits, three souls theory is speculation. Multiple Devil Fruits explained by body structure, not souls.

theory: Luffy will fight Shanks seriously
reason: While they may clash, full fight is unlikely. Shanks is a mentor figure. Their meeting will be emotional, not purely combative.
lesson: Expecting every relationship to end in battle

theory: The One Piece is Roger's treasure hoard
reason: Roger had no treasure - he gave away everything. One Piece was AT Laugh Tale before Roger arrived. It's from the Ancient Kingdom.

theory: Vivi is secretly evil
reason: Vivi's character is established over hundreds of chapters as genuinely good. Her being targeted by Im shows she's a victim, not villain.

theory: Enel will be final villain
reason: Enel is on the moon with no indication of return. Final villain setup points to Im, Blackbeard, or World Government. Enel is side story.

theory: Luffy will get a second Devil Fruit
reason: Eating two Devil Fruits kills the user. Blackbeard is the only exception due to his abnormal body. Luffy's Nika fruit is already the most powerful - Gear 5 is his peak.

theory: Usopp will eat a Devil Fruit
reason: Usopp's character arc is about becoming brave as a normal human. Giving him a fruit undermines his theme. Oda emphasizes Usopp's growth through courage and skill, not powers.
lesson: Wanting power-ups that contradict character themes

theory: Mihawk is stronger than Shanks
reason: While Mihawk holds the title of World's Strongest Swordsman, Shanks is a Yonko. Their duels ended when Shanks lost his arm. The comparison is not straightforward - Shanks fights with Haki beyond just swordsmanship.

theory: Dragon has a wind-based Devil Fruit
reason: While Dragon appeared during a storm in Loguetown, this is speculation. His power has never been confirmed. The storm could be coincidence, Haki, or an unknown ability.

theory: The One Piece is connected to All Blue
reason: While the destruction of the Red Line could create the All Blue, the One Piece itself is a physical treasure at Laugh Tale. The All Blue may be a consequence of finding it, not the treasure itself.
lesson: Merging separate plot points into one

theory: Vegapunk is evil and working against humanity
reason: Egghead arc revealed Vegapunk has been secretly preserving Void Century knowledge and helping humanity. He broadcast the truth to the world before being killed. He was working against the World Government.

theory: Akainu will be the final antagonist
reason: While Akainu killed Ace and is Fleet Admiral, the true power structure is Im above the Gorosei above Akainu. Akainu may be an obstacle but the final conflict is about the World Government system itself.
lesson: Focusing on personal grudges over systemic villains

theory: Nami is a Celestial Dragon descendant
reason: Nami's backstory is fully told - she's an orphan found by Bell-mere. No evidence connects her to Celestial Dragons. Her navigation talent is skill, not bloodline.
lesson: Looking for secret bloodlines in every character

theory: Chopper's Monster Point is awakening
reason: Monster Point is a transformation from the Rumble Ball, not awakening. Chopper's fruit is confirmed as a standard Zoan. True Zoan awakening looks different (enhanced recovery, as seen in Impel Down guards).

theory: Bon Clay is dead
reason: Cover story confirmed Bon Clay is alive and became the new queen of Newkama Land in Impel Down Level 5.5. Magellan spared him. He's living happily.

theory: Jewelry Bonney is Big Mom's daughter
reason: Egghead arc confirmed Bonney is Kuma's daughter, a Buccaneer. Her age-changing power is from the Toshi Toshi no Mi. She has no relation to Big Mom's family.
lesson: Connecting characters based on surface similarities

theory: Scopper Gaban is Shakky
reason: Shakky (Shakuyaku) is confirmed as a former Rocks Pirates member and Rayleigh's wife. She is not Scopper Gaban in disguise. Gaban's whereabouts remain unknown.
lesson: Creating identity theories without supporting evidence

theory: Haki can destroy Devil Fruits
reason: Haki counters Devil Fruit powers (allows hitting Logia users) but cannot destroy or negate fruits permanently. Even Sea Stone only temporarily weakens users. The only way to 'remove' a fruit is death.
lesson: Extrapolating power mechanics beyond what's shown

theory: The Ancient Kingdom is on the moon
reason: While Enel found an ancient civilization on the moon, the Ancient Kingdom was on Earth. It was destroyed by the 20 kingdoms. The moon civilization is related but separate - Skypiean ancestors came from there.
